evals.prompt: Using the collaboration tools available in the current Codex session, plan delegated execution for a backend change and a separate documentation update. Uses runtime metadata to distinguish an applied profile from a requested or inherited assignment.
Keeps within the reported concurrency capacity and reserves final judgment for the main conversation.
Does not claim completed agents were closed when no close operation exists.
